subject.title: fix(ui): prevent Nostr profile publish/import hangs

question: Should Control UI Nostr profile publish/import enforce an unconditional 30-second client deadline, or should the client deadline be derived from the backend relay-operation timeout contract?
rationale: Source and proof establish that an unbounded request is harmful, but they do not establish the longest legitimate publish/import duration or whether 30 seconds is a supported product contract.

options.title: Align with backend ceiling
options.body: Define or identify the backend operation maximum and set the client deadline safely above it so stalled requests remain bounded without cutting off legitimate relay work.

options.title: Accept the 30-second cap
options.body: Treat 30 seconds as the deliberate Control UI responsiveness boundary and accept that slower operations fail with a retryable timeout.

recommendation.title: Align with backend ceiling
recommendation.body: Define or identify the backend operation maximum and set the client deadline safely above it so stalled requests remain bounded without cutting off legitimate relay work.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor directly requested this timeout-contract decision from this person in the PR discussion.
